summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting an initial PDMR dealing notification under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The trustee of the Company's Buy As You Earn Share Plan purchased 21 ordinary shares of nominal 1.0769 pence each (ISIN GB00BM8PJY71) on 28 September 2026 for Chief Customer Operations Officer James Holian at 6.9486 per share on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine employee share-plan disclosure with no board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium or change of control; no special-situation or risk-arb angle arises.
